Other interests

Phone photography

A camera on your phone is one of my favourite inventions of the 20th century. I walk most mornings and am always looking for interesting things to photograph - I like seeing the abstract in the daily and familiar. I do have a proper DSLR, but it's bulky and not very spontaneous to use. I use it for filming mostly.

Writing

I love to write, I've written 1000s and 1000s of wrd over the years. I even wrote a rather odd sci-fi (speculative fiction) novel for NaNoWriMo a few years ago.

I've written screenplays (sometimes very loosely to allow the direction and action to have more of a free flow) for a few short films and the outlines for story-based music videos. I have a couple of unfilmed screenplays sitting around so if you'd be interested in a film collaboration, talk to me.
